message: The other day, I was chatting with my friend Sarah, who has a knack for panicking at the first sign of trouble. She was convinced we’d be caught in a blizzard with no food or water. While I reassured her, I realized how much I appreciated having a go-bag ready just in case. It’s not about being alarmist; it’s just a way to keep calm when life throws us a curveball. How do you keep your family ready without the stress? 😊
